instruction: Create a still image from the current video position and save it as 'still_frame.png' on the Desktop.

parameters.window_name: Interstellar Movie - Interstellar Movie - Official Trailer - VLC media player

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires capturing video screenshot and saving as 'still_frame.png' on Desktop. Evaluator checks: (1) file exists, (2) valid PNG, (3) size 10KB-50MB. State-based evaluation.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies all instruction requirements: file exists at correct path, file is valid PNG format, file has reasonable size
Getter extracts the right state: checks exact file path '/home/user/Desktop/still_frame.png', validates PNG format using 'file' command, retrieves file size
Metric comparison logic is correct: awards 0.4 for existence, 0.3 for PNG validity, 0.3 for size range (10KB-50MB)
Scoring breakdown matches metadata specification and makes semantic sense
No postconfig needed - file-based verification is state-based and doesn't require UI to remain open
Edge cases handled properly: returns {exists: False, size: 0, is_png: False} when file not found
Size bounds (10KB-50MB) are semantically reasonable for video screenshot verification
